reference_sql:
WITH delivered AS (
  -- one row per delivered order: the person who placed it and the day it was placed
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_day
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
firsts AS (
  -- one row per person: the day of the first delivered order
  SELECT customer_unique_id, MIN(order_day) AS first_day
  FROM delivered
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
people AS (
  -- one row per person whose first delivered order was placed in 2017: its month, and 1 when the person came back
  SELECT f.customer_unique_id,
         CAST(date_trunc('month', f.first_day) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
         MAX(CASE WHEN d.order_day > f.first_day AND d.order_day <= DATE '2018-08-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS came_back
  FROM firsts AS f
  JOIN delivered AS d ON d.customer_unique_id = f.customer_unique_id
  WHERE f.first_day >= DATE '2017-01-01'
    AND f.first_day < DATE '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY f.customer_unique_id, f.first_day
),
months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2017
  SELECT CAST(r.month_start AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM range(DATE '2017-01-01', DATE '2018-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS r(month_start)
)
SELECT m.cohort_month,
       COUNT(p.customer_unique_id) AS cohort_customers,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.came_back = 1) AS repeat_customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.came_back = 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.customer_unique_id), 0), 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN people AS p ON p.cohort_month = m.cohort_month
GROUP BY m.cohort_month
ORDER BY m.cohort_month

WITH delivered AS (
  -- one row per delivered order: the person, the day it was placed and the person's first delivered day
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_day,
         MIN(CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)) OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_unique_id) AS first_day
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
people AS (
  -- one row per person whose first delivered order was placed in 2017, with that month and the later delivered orders
  SELECT customer_unique_id,
         CAST(date_trunc('month', MIN(first_day)) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_day > first_day AND order_day <= DATE '2018-08-31') AS later_orders
  FROM delivered
  WHERE first_day >= DATE '2017-01-01'
    AND first_day < DATE '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2017
  SELECT CAST(g.month_start AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2017-01-01', DATE '2017-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS g(month_start)
)
SELECT m.cohort_month,
       COUNT(p.customer_unique_id) AS cohort_customers,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.later_orders > 0) AS repeat_customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.later_orders > 0) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.customer_unique_id), 0), 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN people AS p ON p.cohort_month = m.cohort_month
GROUP BY m.cohort_month
ORDER BY m.cohort_month

WITH delivered AS (
  -- one row per delivered order: the person who placed it and the day it was placed
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
         CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS order_day
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
firsts AS (
  -- one row per person: the day of the first delivered order
  SELECT customer_unique_id, MIN(order_day) AS first_day
  FROM delivered
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
people AS (
  -- one row per person whose first delivered order was placed in 2017: its month, and whether a later delivered order exists
  SELECT f.customer_unique_id,
         CAST(date_trunc('month', f.first_day) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
         EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM delivered AS d
           WHERE d.customer_unique_id = f.customer_unique_id
             AND d.order_day > f.first_day
             AND d.order_day <= DATE '2018-08-31'
         ) AS came_back
  FROM firsts AS f
  WHERE f.first_day >= DATE '2017-01-01'
    AND f.first_day < DATE '2018-01-01'
),
months AS (
  -- one row per month of 2017
  SELECT CAST(r.month_start AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM range(DATE '2017-01-01', DATE '2018-01-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS r(month_start)
)
SELECT m.cohort_month,
       COUNT(p.customer_unique_id) AS cohort_customers,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.came_back THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.came_back THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(p.customer_unique_id), 0), 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN people AS p ON p.cohort_month = m.cohort_month
GROUP BY m.cohort_month
ORDER BY m.cohort_month

solver.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS u, CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) AS day
  FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
f AS (SELECT u, MIN(day) AS first_day FROM d GROUP BY u),
p AS (
  SELECT f.u, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', f.first_day) AS DATE) AS m,
         BOOL_OR(d.day > f.first_day AND d.day <= DATE '2018-08-31') AS rep
  FROM f JOIN d ON d.u = f.u
  WHERE f.first_day >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND f.first_day < DATE '2018-01-01'
  GROUP BY f.u, f.first_day
),
a AS (SELECT m, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN rep THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r FROM p GROUP BY m),
ms AS (SELECT CAST(g AS DATE) AS cohort_month FROM generate_series(DATE '2017-01-01', DATE '2017-12-01', INTERVAL 1 MONTH) t(g))
SELECT ms.cohort_month,
       COALESCE(a.n, 0) AS cohort_customers,
       COALESCE(a.r, 0) AS repeat_customers,
       ROUND(100.0 * a.r / a.n, 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM ms LEFT JOIN a ON a.m = ms.cohort_month
ORDER BY ms.cohort_month
